parsed.production_notes: The video uses human-recorded footage for the narrative part, featuring real actors. The AI tutor is represented by a common stock animation of a humanoid robot, making the production a mix of real and generated/stock elements.
parsed.interaction_pattern: A 'before/after' testimonial followed by a demonstration of the app's core mechanic: an AI tutor quizzes a learner, who makes a mistake and receives live correction.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Marathi and English. There is no background music or song.

characters.appearance: A young South Asian woman in her early 20s with a slender build and a medium-brown complexion. She has large, expressive dark brown eyes, well-defined eyebrows, and long black hair tied back neatly in a bun. Her face is heart-shaped and she has a friendly smile.
characters.wardrobe: Initially, a dark navy blue blazer over a white collared shirt. Later, a short-sleeved navy blue hotel uniform top with a white collar and cuffs, and a white apron. She wears a name tag that reads 'SHRUTI PATIL TRAINEE'.
characters.demeanor: Initially secretive and excited, then professional and confident, and finally engaged and curious while interacting with the AI.
